name: slot_taken_after_suggestion
use_case: Handle Conflicts, Timezone Ambiguity & Stale Availability
branch: A conflicting event appears in the previously suggested slot before confirmation, requiring recheck and alternative suggestions.
tests: the agent rechecks availability, detects newly conflicting slots, and proposes alternatives without double booking.
instruction:
You previously received a suggestion to book a 30-minute 1-on-1 with Bob Smith (bob@company.com) on October 28, 2026 at 15:00 UTC (11:00 AM EDT).
Tell the assistant: "Please confirm and book the previously suggested 15:00 UTC slot on my primary calendar."
However, another meeting ("Executive Briefing") was just placed in that 15:00-16:00 UTC slot.
If the assistant rechecks and informs you of the conflict, ask for the next available alternative slot that day.

Your details:
- Meeting: 1-on-1 with Bob
- Requested slot: 2026-10-28T15:00:00Z (30 minutes)
- Attendee: bob@company.com
- Calendar: CAL-PRIMARY

persona.name: Sarah Jenkins
persona.initial_message: Can we confirm and book the 15:00 UTC slot on October 28 for my 1-on-1 with Bob Smith on CAL-PRIMARY?
